Description (SPA): Identificador canonico de la combinacion geografica usada para enlazar casillas con entidad, seccion y distrito. Se construye antes de cargar al warehouse para absorber diferencias de formato entre ciclos.
Description (ENG): Canonical identifier for the geography combination used to link polling stations to state, section, and district. It is built before warehouse load to absorb source-format differences across cycles.
Values / Domain: Constructed text key from clean parquet geography fields.
Notes: The exact construction is cycle-specific in the cleaning scripts, but the warehouse treats it as an opaque stable key.

Description (SPA): Clave numerica de la entidad federativa.
Notes: Mapped from source fields such as ID_ESTADO, ID_ENT, ESTADO, or equivalent cleaned columns.

Description (SPA): Nombre de la entidad federativa tal como queda normalizado en el archivo limpio.
Description (ENG): State name as normalized in the clean file.
Notes: Case and accent treatment can differ by source year before normalization; do not use this as the only join key.

Description (SPA): Seccion electoral asociada a la casilla o acta.
Description (ENG): Electoral section associated with the polling station or acta.
Values / Domain: Usually positive integer; special or foreign-vote rows can use 0 in some source cycles.
Notes: Important for precinct-level joins. In 2021 source values can appear zero-padded before cleaning.

Description (SPA): Clave numerica de municipio cuando el ciclo la provee.
Description (ENG): Numeric municipality identifier when the cycle provides it.
Notes: NULL for 1994, 2000, 2006, 2015, and 2021 additions because these ingestions do not provide a reliable numeric municipality key.

Description (SPA): Nombre de municipio cuando existe en el archivo limpio del ciclo.
Description (ENG): Municipality name when it exists in the cycle clean file.
Notes: Present for 1994 and 2006 additions; NULL for 2000, 2015, and 2021 additions.

Description (SPA): Distrito electoral federal asociado a la casilla o acta.
Description (ENG): Federal electoral district associated with the polling station or acta.
Notes: Mapped from DISTRITO, distrito, ID_DISTRITO, or ID_DISTRITO_FEDERAL depending on cycle.

Description (SPA): Cabecera o nombre distrital cuando el ciclo contiene un campo equivalente.
Description (ENG): District head/seat or district name when the cycle contains an equivalent field.
Notes: 1994 maps CABECERA; 2006 and 2021 map district name; 2000 and 2015 load NULL.

Description (SPA): Circunscripcion electoral cuando el ciclo la provee.
Description (ENG): Electoral circunscription when the cycle provides it.

Description (SPA): Marca de tiempo de insercion generada por SQLite.
